name: Exec session wake (continue prompt + ALS clear + immediate/steer notify)

target.gitSubject: fix(otel): fail closed when configured TLS material is invalid (#118648)
target.note: Patch was authored against this exact checkout. Rebase/retest before applying to other commits.

problems.summary: When outbound delivery is disabled (webchat/dashboard), exec completion wake forced HEARTBEAT_OK-only and hid the turn in Control UI.
Background exec notifyOnExit inherited a disposed attempt transcript ALS, so admitUserTurn failed before embedded agent run started.
notifyOnExit used intent:event, so agent-level nextDueMs deferred dashboard wakes for minutes after main heartbeats; active sessions only busy-retried instead of steering.
Model-facing exec guidance, running-exec responses, and sessions_yield text encouraged process polling or subagent-only waits, conflicting with completion-wake handoff.

notifyOnExit steered into an in-flight LLM stream; sessions_yield then aborted the run and cancelled the uncommitted steer, so same-session exec completions were lost. yieldMs running exec was also not treated as continuation evidence.
